Class ShoppingCartService

java.lang.Object
am.gortsup.testing.service.ShoppingCartService
public class ShoppingCartService extends Object
Service managing user shopping carts, item management, coupons, and cart totals calculation.

  • Method Details

    • addItem

      public void addItem(String cartId, Product product, int quantity)
      Adds an item to the shopping cart. If already present, increments quantity.
      Parameters:
      cartId - shopping cart identifier
      product - product to add
      quantity - quantity to add (1 to 99)
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if product is null, inactive, or quantity is out of range

    • removeItem

      public void removeItem(String cartId, String productId)
      Removes a product completely from the cart.
      Parameters:
      cartId - cart ID
      productId - product ID
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if item not in cart

    • updateQuantity

      public void updateQuantity(String cartId, String productId, int newQuantity)
      Updates the exact quantity of a product in the cart.
      Parameters:
      cartId - cart ID
      productId - product ID
      newQuantity - new quantity (1 to 99)
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if product not in cart
      ValidationException - if quantity is not between 1 and 99

    • applyCoupon

      public void applyCoupon(String cartId, Coupon coupon, LocalDate currentDate)
      Applies a discount coupon to the cart. Validates expiration date, usage limit, and minimum order amount.
      Parameters:
      cartId - cart ID
      coupon - coupon entity
      currentDate - date against which to check expiration
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if coupon is null
      InvalidCouponException - if coupon is expired, depleted, or cart subtotal invalid input: '<' minOrderAmount

    • removeCoupon

      public void removeCoupon(String cartId)
      Removes the currently applied coupon from the cart.
      Parameters:
      cartId - cart ID

    • calculateSubtotal

      public double calculateSubtotal(String cartId)
      Calculates the cart subtotal before discounts and taxes.
      Parameters:
      cartId - cart ID
      Returns:
      subtotal rounded to 2 decimal places

    • calculateDiscountAmount

      public double calculateDiscountAmount(String cartId)
      Calculates discount amount based on the currently applied coupon.
      Parameters:
      cartId - cart ID
      Returns:
      discount monetary amount (0.0 if no coupon applied)

    • calculateTotal

      public double calculateTotal(String cartId, double taxRatePercentage)
      Calculates final total: (subtotal - discount) + tax.
      Parameters:
      cartId - cart ID
      taxRatePercentage - tax rate (0.0 to 100.0)
      Returns:
      total rounded to 2 decimal places
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if tax rate is invalid
